answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded basalt. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its walnut never becomes influence. Net effect on the vault: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal qidwr.
